title: The Baneful
summary: +1 shortsword gains another +1 and can Bane on hit when bound.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 to attacks. Martial, one-handed, Finesse, Light and Dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Favoured Weapon: Binding it through Eldritch Knight Weapon Bond, Pact Weapon or Hexed Weapon adds another +1 to attack and damage.
fields.Baneful Bond: While bound, on hit a failed DC 14 Charisma save inflicts Bane for 2 turns. Bane subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saves. The combat log does not show the save.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Melee weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Weapon damage on hit. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing removes it. Standard-mode hits deal 2 extra Piercing. In Honour Mode, qualifying damage sources deal 2 extra of their original damage type.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
